mainEntity.name: Do granite countertops require sealing, and how often?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most granite countertops require sealing to protect them from stains and moisture absorption. The frequency of sealing depends on the type of granite and the sealer used; generally, it's recommended every 1-3 years. Lighter-colored or more porous granites might need sealing more frequently than darker, denser varieties. We apply a professional-grade sealer during installation. As a practical tradeoff, regular sealing ensures the longevity and beauty of your countertops, preventing common issues like oil or wine stains from penetrating the stone.
